parsed.rationale: Both `ShowContainerProtocol` and `TrackContainerProtocol` in package `Playback` share four fields identically — `isStale:Bool`, `lastRefreshedAt:Date?`, `pageToken:String?`, and `item` — differing only in the concrete type of `item` (`Show` vs `Track`). This is the canonical PAT pattern: a single protocol with `associatedtype Item` captures the shared shape, and the two existing protocols either become typealiased conformances or are removed entirely. Neither record carries any restraint marker (`is_test`, `is_mock`, `is_sample_app`, `is_codegen` are all false), so no intentional-duplication rule applies. Introducing `ContainerProtocol<Item>` eliminates the structural duplication and makes the relationship between the two container abstractions explicit in the type system.
